0.comment: Waqar: The Surging Darkness hotspot, Under Siege
0.content: In The Surging Darkness (5.1) the Traveler may choose to reinforce a stronghold near the Scions of the Canopy that is beset by Abyssal monsters, where Achiyaku and Wayta guard civilians and wounded who cannot be moved. After the fight Achiyaku plans to escort the first group to the Scions of the Canopy and call reinforcements for the rest. The choice affects which survivors, Waqar among them, are saved in Despair Engulfs the Heavens.
